title: Zoje ZJ3800-PLB-J-BD
subtitle: 2-Needle Feed-Off-Arm Chainstitch Machine (Pneumatic Lift, Bottom Feed, Direct-Drive)

purposeAndApplication.purpose: The ZJ3800-PLB-J-BD is a 2-needle feed-off-arm chainstitch machine from Zoje's ZJ3800 series. The suffix breaks down as: -PLB = pneumatic lift + bottom feed, -J = standard Japanese market configuration, -BD = direct-drive (built-in AC servo motor). Used for attaching waistbands, hemming jeans, and tubular garment operations.
applications: Waistband attaching on jeans and trousers
2-needle parallel chainstitch operations requiring extra feeding accuracy
Production lines needing direct-drive energy savings
purposeAndApplication.industry: Jeans manufacturing, trouser production, sportswear, work-wear assembly

overviewDescription: Made by Zoje (Zhejiang, China). Part of the ZJ3800 chainstitch family — a 2-needle flat-bed chainstitch machine using TV×7 (or 149×7) needle system. The base ZJ3800 runs 4,500 rpm with 4 mm stitch length; the `-BD` direct-drive variant runs 5,000 rpm per zoje-america.
